purpose: Part 4/5 of verified exact 50-record item effect batch 029; together these files contain exactly 50 reviewed records from the current 130-record checkpoint.

items/fan-of-furious-flame.name: Fan of Furious Flame
items/fan-of-furious-flame.effectSummary: Three times per day, the fan creates a 30-foot cone that makes nonmagical open flames explode and then permanently extinguishes them; Reflex DC 15 halves the explosion damage, nearby combustibles do not catch, and magical fires are unaffected. Candles (1-5): 1d4 in a 5-ft. diameter; candelabra (6+): 1d6 in 5-ft. diameter; lantern: 1d8 in a 5-ft. square; torch: 1d10 in a 10-ft. square; campfire: 1d12 in a 10-ft. square.

items/gogondy.name: Gogondy
items/gogondy.effectSummary: A bottle contains six glasses. Each glass produces one d% result and side effect: 01-15 nothing, 1d3 temporary Dex and 1d3 temporary Int; 16-30 divination at CL 10, 1d6 temporary Dex and 1d3 temporary Int; 31-60 vision on a tangential topic, 1d6 temporary Dex and 1d6 temporary Int; 61-80 contact other plane (Elemental Plane of Earth, CL 10), side effect as the spell; 81-90 vision on a specified topic, 2d6 temporary Dex and 2d6 temporary Int; 91-100 contact other plane (Outer Plane/intermediate, CL 10), side effect as the spell.

items/harper-pin.name: Harper Pin
items/harper-pin.effectSummary: The lesser Harper pin functions identically to a ring of mind shielding. The greater pin continuously grants immunity to magic missile, nondetection, undetectable alignment, and +5 resistance on saves against mind-affecting effects. When worn by an evil creature, a greater pin turns black and makes discordant jangling sounds, imposing -10 on Move Silently checks.

items/hat-of-disguise.name: Hat of Disguise
items/hat-of-disguise.effectSummary: While worn, the hat lets the wearer alter appearance as with alter self. As part of the disguise, the hat itself can appear as other headwear such as a comb, ribbon, headband, cap, coif, hood, or helmet.

items/horn-of-dragons.name: Horn of Dragons
items/horn-of-dragons.effectSummary: Blowing the horn is a full-round action; 1 round later it summons an adult dragon to a point within 100 feet. The dragon serves the user to the best of its ability for 1 hour, then disappears, and also disappears if slain or dispelled. The horn works once per month. The user's alignment determines the dragon: LG/NG/LN bronze; CG/N/CN copper; LE/NE green; CE black.

items/horn-of-valhalla.name: Horn of Valhalla
items/horn-of-valhalla.effectSummary: The horn can be blown once every 7 days to summon human barbarian constructs that arrive with normal starting equipment and obey the user's combat commands for up to 1 hour or until slain. Using a horn without its prerequisite causes the summoned barbarians to attack the user. Random horn types: 01-40 silver, 2d4+2 2nd-level barbarians, no prerequisite; 41-75 brass, 2d4+1 3rd-level, spellcaster level 1+; 76-90 bronze, 2d4 4th-level, proficiency with all martial weapons or bardic music; 91-100 iron, 1d4+1 5th-level, same martial/bardic prerequisite.

items/idol-of-the-dragon.name: Idol of the Dragon
items/idol-of-the-dragon.effectSummary: While carried in statuette form, the idol grants the listed energy resistance; once per week, throwing it into the air and speaking the command word turns it into the listed full-size living dragon for up to 1 hour. The dragon obeys its owner, can be dismissed early, and a successful targeted dispel magic returns it to idol form; if slain in dragon form, the idol is destroyed. Versions: white wyrmling cold 5; brass wyrmling fire 5; black very young acid 5; copper very young acid 5; green young acid 10; bronze young electricity 10; blue juvenile electricity 10; silver juvenile cold 10; red young adult fire 10; gold young adult fire 10.

items/iron-flask.name: Iron Flask
items/iron-flask.effectSummary: Speaking the command word can trap one extraplanar creature within 60 feet if it fails Will DC 19; only one creature can be held at a time. Removing the stopper frees it. If the releaser speaks the command word, the freed creature is forced to serve for 1 hour; otherwise it acts naturally. A second attempt to trap the same creature grants it +2 on the save and makes it completely hostile. A newly found flask is empty on 01-50 or contains the creature listed by its captured d% table. Contents table 1: d% | Contents | d% | Contents; 01-50 | Empty | 89 | Demon (glabrezu); 51-54 | Large air elemental | 90 | Demon (succubus); 55-58 | Arrowhawk | 91 | Devil (osyluth); 59-62 | Large earth elemental | 92 | Devil (barbazu); 63-66 | Xorn | 93 | Devil (erinyes); 67-70 | Large fire elemental | 94 | Devil (cornugon); 71-74 | Salamander | 95 | Celestial (avoral); 75-78 | Large water elemental | 96 | Celestial (ghaele); 79-82 | Adult tojanida | 97 | Formian myrmarch; 83-84 | Red slaad | 98 | Blue slaad; 85-86 | Formian taskmaster (alone) | 99 | Rakshasa; 87 | Demon (vrock) | 100 | Demon (balor) or devil (pit fiend) - equal chance for either; 88 | Demon (hezrou)

items/longbow-composite-558.name: Longbow, composite
items/longbow-composite-558.effectSummary: A composite longbow requires two hands and can be used while mounted. Each bow has a Strength rating; if the wielder's Strength bonus is below it, attacks take -2. The bow allows adding Strength bonus to damage up to its rating, but never more than the wielder actually has. Each +1 of supported Strength bonus adds 100 gp to cost. For proficiency and feats it counts as a longbow.

items/mithral-685.name: Mithral
items/mithral-685.effectSummary: Mithral armor is one category lighter for movement and similar limits (heavy -> medium, medium -> light; light remains light), reduces arcane spell failure by 10 percentage points, raises maximum Dexterity bonus by 2, and reduces armor check penalty by 3 to a minimum of 0. Mithral items weigh half normal; weapon handedness/size is unchanged. Mithral weapons and armor are always masterwork, with masterwork cost already included. Mithral has hardness 15 and 30 hp per inch. Cost modifiers: light armor +1,000 gp; medium +4,000 gp; heavy +9,000 gp; shield +1,000 gp; other items +500 gp/lb.
